description.narrative: Wind Power Energía S.A. (WPE) is a member of Grupo IMPSA, which has designed, produced and marketed high capacity wind power equipment since September 2008 in Cabo de Santo Agostinho, State of Pernambuco, Brazil.WPE also provides construction services, including the assembly and installation of generators, electrical components, and other industrial equipment for the energy sector. Its annual production capacity is 300 wind generators and it is expanding to produce electromechanical equipment for hydroelectric plants, as well as increasing its capacity for producing wind power generators. WPE primarily supplies wind farms in Brazil and, depending on demand, may begin to supply wind farms in Argentina, Chile, Uruguay, and other locations. It is the only company in Latin America with the technology to produce this kind of equipment. Currently, the assembly of domestic and imported parts at its manufacturing plant in Recife involves a heavy workload for the company’s electrical engineers.This IIC operation seeks to provide Wind Power Energía with financing for working capital for its growing production and supply of wind generators and to meet the increased demand for wind farms in Santa Catarina and Ceará, in Brazil.
